gates.detail: 10/10 agree [control_peak1_bw=1.1005 vs ref 1.1005; control_trough_bw=0.74753 vs ref 0.7475; control_peak2_bw=1.0981 vs ref 1.0981; patient_peak1_bw=1.0151 vs ref 1.0151; patient_trough_bw=0.84096 vs ref 0.841; patient_peak2_bw=1.0342 vs ref 1.0342; first_peak_cohens_d=1.3332 vs ref 1.3332; n_control=208 vs ref 208; n_patient=499 vs ref 499; landmark_indep_maxabsdiff_bw=0 vs ref 0]
gates.citation: Horsak B, Slijepcevic D, Raberger AM, Schwab C, Worisch M, Zeppelzauer M (2020), Sci Data 7:143 (GaitRec, figshare collection 4788012, CC-BY 4.0); vertical GRF (F_V_PRO), healthy controls vs knee-pathology cohort. Independent cross-check: scipy.signal.find_peaks (Virtanen et al. 2020, Nat Methods 17:261-272), prominence-ranked morphological landmark detection.

reference.citation: Horsak B, Slijepcevic D, Raberger AM, Schwab C, Worisch M, Zeppelzauer M (2020), Sci Data 7:143 (GaitRec, figshare collection 4788012, CC-BY 4.0); vertical GRF (F_V_PRO), healthy controls vs knee-pathology cohort. Independent cross-check: scipy.signal.find_peaks (Virtanen et al. 2020, Nat Methods 17:261-272), prominence-ranked morphological landmark detection.
reference.description: cohort contrast of stance-phase vertical-GRF landmarks between GaitRec healthy controls and the knee-pathology group reproduces the knee-pathology signature -- control loading peak 1.10 BW vs patient 1.02 BW, control mid-stance trough 0.75 BW vs patient 0.84 BW -- with a large first-peak effect size (d=1.33), on 208 vs 499 subjects; AND guards the grfLandmarks extraction itself against an INDEPENDENT window-free detector (scipy.signal.find_peaks: two most-prominent humps + valley between), which reproduces all six group-mean landmarks bit-for-bit (max |op - independent| = 0)
